question: A silicon sample is simultaneously doped with both donor and acceptor impurities. The donor concentration is $N_D = 1 \times 10^{16} \text{ atoms/cm}^3$ and the acceptor concentration is $N_A = 4 \times 10^{16} \text{ atoms/cm}^3$. If the intrinsic carrier concentration of silicon is $n_i = 10^{10} \text{ atoms/cm}^3$, identify the majority charge carrier and its approximate concentration.
